 Pat McAfee spurns FAA ground stop, rides horseback in 'College GameDay' skit you won't soon forget
 David Suggs
 • 
 Add Sporting News on Google 
 div))]:my-4" data-testid="advert--mobile_branded_logo" id="Branded_Logo_Mobile"> 
 Like most in the sports world, the "College GameDay" crew was left to grapple with the effects of Friday's ground stop early Saturday morning.
 The decree, ordered by the Federal Aviation Association amid concerns over a telecommunications outage impacting air traffic control, lasted just hours. And yet, the incident saw dozens of matchups affected, including Oklahoma's tilt with Ole Miss, which was moved from Saturday afternoon at 4:15 p.m. ET to Sunday afternoon at 1 p.m. ET.
 "College GameDay" went off without a hitch — the cast and crew arrived in the lead-up to Friday's announcement. That didn't stop ESPN's flagship college football program from poking fun at the announcement.
 With that, here's how Pat McAfee paid homage to Friday's ground stop during Saturday's program, held at Boise State.
 MORE:  What games were affected by FAA ground stop? 
 Pat McAfee mocks FAA ground stop with horseback appearance at 'College GameDay'
 McAfee took to the makeshift "College GameDay" set on his humble steed on Saturday morning. The punter-turned-analyst was the last of the cast to arrive on the scene, drawing concern for those of McAfee-tinted disposition.
 "And as you might have heard, people have had some travel difficulties," host Rece Davis said. "That includes Pat McAfee. I think Pat is trying to find his way here. We're certainly hopeful we find him soon and that McAfee can make it to the set."
 The 40-something responded to Davis' request with aplomb. Accompanied by an old nag — and soundtracked by triumphant music — McAfee strode onto the set in style.
 "Don't you worry about an airplane," McAfee proclaimed. "Don't you worry about an automobile. I'm riding on Rodeo. A horse that was, of course, built to be among these Broncos fans."
 Rece Davis: "And as you might have heard, people have had some travel difficulties... That includes Pat McAfee..." Pat McAfee arrives on horseback to open 'College GameDay' in Boise. McAfee: "I have never rode a horse before. I certainly lied to them to let that happen." https://t.co/Wopf4svRuo
— Awful Announcing (@awfulannouncing) November 14, 2026 Boise State fans, indeed, embraced McAfee during his appearance, cheering him on as he made the long walk to the "College GameDay" set.
 McAfee showcased humility upon his arrival, thanking Rodeo — his thoroughbred — for not "bucking [his] ass off."
 MORE:  Oklahoma AD blasts SEC after conference threatens Sooners with forfeit over Ole Miss rift 
 "I have never rode a horse before," McAfee admitted. "I certainly lied to them to let that happen."
 McAfee's latest appearance on "College GameDay" certainly proved eye-catching. While his shtick can at times prove tired to some onlookers, it seemed to enchant Broncos faithful on Saturday morning, a welcome sight given the upheaval that came following the FAA's four hour-long ground stoppage.
